utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Kann ich machen. Worum genau geht es beim Reparatur-Drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Es geht um kleinere Sachen, die wir hier im Haus gemeinsam angehen könnten. Ich sage dir gleich genauer, was gebraucht wird.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Okay, sag mir einfach kurz, was genau ansteht.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know when and where the repairs are happening so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the exact day and location before I say it's okay?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I need the exact day and location first so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I missed the latest bit, what changed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I missed that part too. What changed on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can keep passing the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks. I’ll let folks know as I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing, I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m in. What’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly cleanup and a few small fixes. I’ve got a couple tools if you want to knock out a job.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take one of the small fixes. Point me at the worst one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Quinn. Let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs fixing and what time you want to start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can fix the loose porch step, the hall light, and that screen door, and I can start at 9.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Start at 9, and let me know if you need any tools or a ladder.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I come by for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Come by around 3 p.m. and we’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, I’ll be there around 3 p.m.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is getting organized well. Want me to help connect you with folks who can bring tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please. I can point you to the right folks and let them know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course, I’ll stop by and help with the repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thank you. I still need a few hands for sorting donations and labeling the repair kits, and I’ll bring the checklist over now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’ll sort donations and label the repair kits when the checklist arrives.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few spare tarps and nails I can bring by. What does Bo still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tell me what’s still short, and I’ll see what I can gather.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up steam. Folks are dropping off tools and snacks, so it should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, sounds like a good thing. I might stop by and see if they need another set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I figured they might. If you stop by, they’ll probably be glad for the extra help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me what still needs doing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We still need help with the patching, the cleanup, and setting out the sign-up sheet. I can send you the list if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please send the list so I can check the details and help with the right tasks.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What’s the main thing you need from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly I need a hand getting the drill and a few parts sorted out, then I can bring the rest by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I can handle the drill and parts first. Just bring the rest by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with that repair drive, Jules. I’ll make sure folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Vik. I’ll pass the word along and keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure everyone stays on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I think I missed the update, what changed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: They pushed the date back a week, and I think they’re still sorting out the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it, I missed that part too. Who’s still on the list?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a look at it with you, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey. I’ve got a couple of tools here, so we can get it done.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, let’s see what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ve got the repair drive on my list and I’m keeping it moving.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll keep track of where it’s headed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing and whether we have the right tools lined up. Can we confirm the schedule before anyone starts?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, let’s confirm the schedule first, and I’ll make sure everyone knows what tools we still need before we start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds better. Let’s lock the schedule and list the tools we still need before anyone heads over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive is actually happening today?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, today. I’m checking the details now so we know what time and where.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking, we’re still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like the plan in order and in writing before we start. What’s the first stop?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: First stop is the hardware store, then I’ll write it down as we go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I just heard a little about the repair drive from next door. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s moving along: people are still collecting supplies and checking what’s needed most, so I’m keeping an eye on the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, thanks. I’ll keep an ear out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to check in earlier, Mara, but I lost track for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Oren. We can still make it useful if you can take one thing off the list this week.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can take the lamp repair off the list this week and swing by with the part.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive after school pickup, but I need a bit of notice to line it up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, I’ll let you know the time once I have it lined up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me. Just send it when you know, and I’ll see if I can make it.
